params.1273: Disarm traps and avoid poisonous snakes as you search an ancient pyramid for treasure.
params.1292: Gives Thieving experience and treasures which can be sold for cash.
params.1274: You may attempt the pyramid as often as you wish.
params.1275: Talk to the guardian within the pyramid, or Tarik outside it, to learn more.
params.1276: Every ten Thieving levels after 21, another floor of Jalsavrah becomes accessible.
